import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1_000_000_007;
    static final int maxn = 20;
    static final int N = 2001000;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[] b = new int[N];
    static int[] mp = new int[1 << maxn];
    static int[] tot = new int[maxn];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[maxn];
    static int n;

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans = (int)((long)ans * a % mod);
            a = (int)((long)a * a % mod);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static void reduce(int[] x, int idx) {
        x[idx] %= mod;
        if (x[idx] < 0) x[idx] += mod;
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        for (int len = 1; len < lim; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < lim; i += len * 2) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
                    a[i + j] = (a[i + j] + a[i + j + len]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        for (int len = 1; len < lim; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < lim; i += len * 2) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
                    a[i + j] = (a[i + j] - a[i + j + len] + mod) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] a) {
        int i = a.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && a[i] >= a[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = a.length - 1;
        while (a[j] <= a[i]) j--;
        int tmp = a[i];
        a[i] = a[j];
        a[j] = tmp;
        int left = i + 1, right = a.length - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            tmp = a[left];
            a[left] = a[right];
            a[right] = tmp;
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(in.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(in.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                a[i][j] = (int)((long)a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int pc = Integer.bitCount(i);
            v[pc].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[pc]++;
        }
        int m = n / 2;
        int M = n - m;
        // first half
        int lim1 = 1 << (m * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < lim1; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; j++) {
                int bit = (i >> j) & 1;
                p = (int)((long)p * (bit == 1 ? b[j] : (mod + 1 - b[j]) % mod) % mod);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[m]) {
                int[] s = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                int k = j;
                while (k != 0) {
                    int lsb = k & -k;
                    s[cnt++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k ^= lsb;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, cnt);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < m; jj++) {
                        if (((S[jj] >> s[jj]) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[j];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s));
            }
            f[st] = (f[st] + p) % mod;
        }
        // second half
        int lim2 = 1 << (M * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < lim2; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; j++) {
                int bit = (i >> j) & 1;
                p = (int)((long)p * (bit == 1 ? b[j + n * m] : (mod + 1 - b[j + n * m]) % mod) % mod);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[n - m]) {
                int[] s = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                int k = j;
                while (k != 0) {
                    int lsb = k & -k;
                    s[cnt++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k ^= lsb;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, cnt);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < M; jj++) {
                        if (((S[jj] >> s[jj]) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[(~j) & ((1 << n) - 1)];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s));
            }
            g[st] = (g[st] + p) % mod;
        }
        int ans = 0;
        int size = 1 << tot[m];
        fwt(f, size);
        fwt(g, size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            f[i] = (int)((long)f[i] * g[i] % mod);
        }
        fwt2(f, size);
        for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
            ans = (ans + f[i]) % mod;
        }
        out.println(ans);
        out.flush();
    }
}
